definition: to discover that something is there
description: A building site at golden hour. A young woman in a khaki work shirt and trousers kneels at the bottom of a freshly dug trench, brushing earth away with a paintbrush to uncover a colourful ancient mosaic of a face made of small stones. She raises her other hand to her mouth in surprise and stares at it. Above her, construction workers in hard hats and yellow safety vests lean over the edge and stare down, one putting his hands on his head, while a small digger and a cement mixer stand behind them.

taps.target: the man on the far left

de.answer: Sie bürstet Erde von einem Mosaik.
